specification.problem: Define ternary controlled X (TCX) or controlled Z (TCZ) as a two-qutrit elementary gate that is universal when assisted by arbitrary one-qutrit gates, with one-qutrit elementary gates from Cartan decomposition, and use them to synthesize ternary SWAP, Toffoli and Muthukrishnan-Stroud gates, extended to qudits.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Small finite qutrit gate-level reconstruction: TCX/TCZ definitions, a qutrit Fourier relation, and an outline of SWAP synthesis. The abstract gives no explicit formulas, so these are standard-background instances rather than the paper's exact constructions.

equations.label: TCX gate
equations.description: Control qutrit |c> applies X^c to the target qutrit. This is one standard convention; the paper's exact definition may differ.
equations.justification: The abstract names the TCX gate but gives no formula; this is the standard generalized CNOT form.
assumptions: Control value c applies X^c to the target

equations.label: TCZ gate
equations.description: Control qutrit |c> applies Z^c to the target qutrit.
equations.justification: The abstract names the TCZ gate but gives no formula; this is the standard generalized CZ form.
assumptions: Control value c applies Z^c to the target

equations.label: TCX-TCZ relation
equations.description: The two gates are equivalent up to one-qutrit gates on the target, for a Fourier gate F satisfying F Z F^dagger = X.
equations.justification: Consistent with the abstract's claim that TCX or TCZ is universal with arbitrary one-qutrit gates. Exact conventions for F are assumed.
assumptions: F satisfies F Z F^dagger = X

specification.initial_state: Generic computational-basis input |a,b> with a,b in {0,1,2}; no specific state is given in the abstract.

steps.description: Apply TCX (or TCZ conjugated by F on the target) as the two-qutrit entangling elementary gate, with a as control and b as target.
Illustrative SWAP synthesis (assumed): interleave TCX gates with control and target roles exchanged, plus one-qutrit gates. The exact sequence is not given in the abstract and is not specified here.

specification.measurement: Not specified in the abstract; assume a computational-basis measurement of both qutrits to verify gate action.
specification.classical_postprocessing: None specified; none needed beyond reading out the trit values.
assumptions: Standard qutrit Weyl-Heisenberg conventions are used for X, Z and F.
